# Getting help

Looking for help with Blue Ring Octopus CLI? Start here:

1. **Read the docs.** The [README](../README.md) covers installation and the basics; the
   [usage guide](../docs/USAGE.md) has the full key map, all settings and a troubleshooting section.
2. **Search existing issues.** Your question may already be answered:
   [open and closed issues](https://github.com/burak-can-onarim/blue-ring-octopus-cli/issues?q=is%3Aissue).
3. **Ask or report.** If you are stuck, or you found a bug, open an issue with the
   [issue forms](https://github.com/burak-can-onarim/blue-ring-octopus-cli/issues/new/choose). Include your OS,
   `java -version`, the Ollama model you used and the relevant lines from `logs/octopus.log`.

For security problems, **do not** open a public issue; follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
